caseNameFull: TV PIX, INC. v. ALLARD, COMMISSIONERS OF THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF NEVADA
attorneys: George M. McMillan and Paul A. Richards for appellants., Harvey Dickerson, Attorney General of Nevada, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the District Court to give that court an opportunity to consider the appellants’ motion to file a supplemental complaint based upon changes in the relevant Nevada law.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
